entities.summary: Yurina Hirate  is a Japanese singer and actress. She was the lead performer of the idol group Keyakizaka46 until she started her solo career in 2020. As an actress, she has won awards for her starring role in Hibiki (2018) and appeared in Dragon Zakura 2 (2021) and The Fable: The Killer Who Doesn't Kill (2021).
